items.section: The public history was rewritten without changing the trees
items.text: CNA pins neither easy-gl nor meta-gl (no lock, submodule or SHA check), and the only sibling SHAs recorded in the snapshot (integration docs: easy-gl 0b46d35c, meta-gl 571d3a62) predate metagl::InternalFormat::Rgba16, which EasyGLRenderer.cpp uses for SurfaceFormat::Rg32 since CNA bd2f13050 (2026-09-10); the enumerator first exists in meta-gl 20c8b2dc. Building 009d40f5 against the recorded revisions should fail to compile.
items.evidence: modules/renderers/easygl/src/EasyGLRenderer.cpp (Rg32 case); meta-gl@571d3a62 vs @20c8b2dc include/metagl/Enums.hpp; integration/FINAL_RECONCILIATION.md; cmake/RendererSelection.cmake

items.section: Meta-gl's typed call surface and invalid-input contract
items.text: Under Emscripten CNA forces EASYGL_EMSCRIPTEN_EXCEPTION_MODEL=JS, a variable that exists only from easy-gl deda7a42; an older easy-gl checkout silently ignores it and compiles itself and meta-gl with -fwasm-exceptions, mixing exception ABIs with CNA's JS-lowered ABI plus Asyncify. Nothing checks the sibling revision.
items.evidence: cmake/RendererSelection.cmake (FORCE JS); cmake/BuildPerformance.cmake (cna_emscripten_exception_abi); easy-gl@0b46d35c vs @deda7a42 cmake/EasyGlPlatform.cmake

items.text: easy-gl's four test executables check with 128 plain assert() calls, which compile to nothing under NDEBUG; CNA leaves EASYGL_BUILD_TESTS ON except in its web preset, so a Release GL-identity build compiles easy-gl tests that would pass without checking anything.
items.evidence: easy-gl@deda7a42:tests/smoke/*.cpp, cmake/EasyGlOptions.cmake, CMakePresets.json (emscripten preset note); CMakePresets.json (web) at 009d40f5

items.text: Build hygiene: CNA adds ../easy-gl without EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL and does not force EASYGL_BUILD_TESTS/EXAMPLES OFF outside the web preset, so non-web GL configurations compile four easy-gl test executables (and the SDL example when an SDL3 package is found). Whether their add_test entries reach CNA-root ctest was not established.
items.evidence: cmake/RendererSelection.cmake (add_subdirectory(../easy-gl easy-gl)); CMakeLists.txt (enable_testing after renderer selection); easy-gl@deda7a42:CMakeLists.txt

items.text: Sibling limitation: easygl::Config::enable_debug_logging does nothing (no log_callback exists) and Config::validate_calls is never read.
items.evidence: easy-gl@deda7a42:include/easygl/Config.hpp; git grep enable_debug_logging/validate_calls in src (0 hits); NEXT.md (S1/S2)

items.text: meta-gl exposes no 64-bit query-object read and no GL_GPU_DISJOINT_EXT query; CNA's EasyGLGpuTimerRenderer therefore measures GL_TIME_ELAPSED in 32-bit nanoseconds (saturates at about 4.29 s) and can reject only the all-ones value, not detect disjoint events.

items.section: Device initialization delegates context truth downward
items.text: Sibling documentation gap: meta-gl's Loader.hpp says to initialise once on the GL thread and then hand rendering to any thread, but the function table, availability map, context info, generation counter and listener list are all thread_local, so every GL-calling thread must initialise itself (CNA does, in EnsureCallingThreadContext).
items.evidence: meta-gl@20c8b2dc:include/metagl/Loader.hpp (Thread-safety note); src/Functions.cpp (thread_local GlTable g_gl); src/Context.cpp; modules/renderers/easygl/src/EasyGLRenderer.cpp (metagl::Initialize when !IsInitialized)

items.text: Sibling hazard: easygl::ResourceRegistry::OnContextLost/OnContextRestored iterate the live resources_ vector; a release_gl_handle_only/recreate_gl_resource callback that adds or removes a registration invalidates the iteration. Whether any CNA recoverable object does so during restore was not traced.

No CNA workflow clones free-direct, so no CI job builds or tests FREEDIRECT; its 21 CTests register only with CNA_BUILD_TESTS on a non-Windows, non-Emscripten host with FREEDIRECT selected, and free-direct/free-api are not pinned.

FREEDIRECT stores SetPresentationMode but physical output is always letterboxed, and a virtual-resolution change after the first Present keeps presenting at the old physical scale; CNA's own status document says both need a free-direct change.

free-direct's IDirectDrawSurface::IsLost() always returns DD_OK and Restore() always succeeds (surfaces are resident), so a caller cannot observe surface loss; harmless for the SDL-backed implementation and unused by CNA.
FREEDIRECT is verified on Linux only; CNA's plan leaves Windows and macOS parity unverified.
items.evidence: docs/freedirect-renderer.md (Known, permanent limitations: real Windows/macOS verification)

items.text: cna-city (267b79b9) reports that ClusteredForwardEffect cannot carry many punctual lights together with a texture set; at 009d40f5 the effect's header states this as a design boundary (it binds no material textures, only base colour, metallic and roughness).

living-room-simulator (2bf3f56b, built against CNA 1b3151f2) lists CNA limitations it met (one punctual light per draw, 8-bit IBL cubes, no back-face normal flip, no alpha-tested shadow casters) in its CNA_FINDINGS.md R-1..R-35; none was re-checked at 009d40f5.

StorageContainer's wildcard queries (GetFileNames/GetDirectoryNames with * and ?) have no direct test; the only storage test source has 14 definitions covering refusals, containment and the isolated-storage coupling.
